{{Quote|The clone navy has attempted blockades of neutral systems throughout the provinces&hellip;but Tofen's Raiders ''smash'' them. Many Jedi have tried to stop him&hellip;and failed.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], commenting on Tofen Vane's exploits|<ref name="TCW11" />}}
A [[Battle of an unidentified star system (Valahari Provinces)|battle]] was fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in a neutral '''star system''' within the [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari Provinces]]. After the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] took the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] was forced to establish [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] of neutral worlds of the Valahari Provinces that supplied military aid to the Separatists. [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|Tofen's Raiders]] eventually crushed the blockade.<ref name="TCW11" />
